subject: FYI: Messages for new members will be moderated the first hour or so

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: FYI: Messages for new members will be moderated the first hour or so
parts:
Hi,

although sporadic, I see an increase in spam to the list. In order to
decrease the chances for this to happen, any messages from members
that just joined our group will be moderated by me. As soon as I see
that it is a valid message or if I find that someone joined the group
and did not spam it, I will flag the member as trusted so that
messages will be delivered immediately.

Details: When I see spam from a "member", I can report it to Google
and ban this member from the group. However, the latest is now that
the spammer (most likely a spam bot), join the group, send a few
messages, and leaves the group again. When they do this, technically
I cannot ban them, meaning they might come back again or spam another
group. It is reciprocal: the reporting by others prevent a lot of
spammers to join our group. In either case, the pattern is that the
spam is sent almost immediately (seconds or minutes) after they join
the group.

Cheers

Henrik
